verdict_reason: The parent-diversity confound is largely removed - the Kish effective-parent gap falls from 4.57-7.35 to 0.31-1.98 - while every exactness property of V2 is preserved: segments, windows, all 25 strata and target-domain exposure match exactly in every fold. It is not GREEN because exact parent-count equality is unreachable (proven infeasible at 12 donor slots for folds 1, 2 and 4), a residual gap of -1 to -3 parents remains, and the interval stays conditional on the ten fitted models.

reconfirmed_v2_imbalance.why_donors_add_no_parent: every V2 donor parent already contributes to the common background through its non-donated segments, so returning its donated segments to ABSENT adds segments but never a parent identity. ABSENT is 76 - 12 focal = 64 regardless of donor choice.

parent_exclusive_design.definition: B* = official training minus every segment of every focal parent AND every segment of every donor parent; PRESENT = B* + focal contribution; ABSENT = B* + donor contribution matched exactly per stratum. Because donor parents are removed from the background too, each arm's added parents are exclusive to it and the parent gap becomes 12 - |D| instead of 12.
parent_exclusive_design.structural_reason: each target-domain stratum holds exactly 3 training segments across 2 or 3 parents, and the specific holders must occupy donor slots that must simultaneously cover 16 source strata of about 23 segments each. With 12 slots and each parent spanning only 3-4 strata the joint covering problem is infeasible for folds 1, 2 and 4.
parent_exclusive_design.cross_check: relaxing the slot budget while holding every other constraint fixed makes folds 1 and 4 feasible at 13 and fold 2 at 15, confirming the binding constraint is the slot budget rather than missing data
parent_exclusive_design.chosen_resolution: minimum donor slots per fold that admit an EXACT match: {"1": 13, "2": 15, "3": 12, "4": 13, "5": 12}
parent_exclusive_design.residual_gap_direction: ABSENT now holds 0 to 3 MORE parents than PRESENT, the opposite sign and roughly a ninth the magnitude of V2's deficit

alternative_partition_search.question: could a different five-fold partition of the same 60 focal-eligible parents be exactly feasible at 12 slots in every fold?
alternative_partition_search.method: randomised partitions under seed 20260909, each fold tested by exact ILP
alternative_partition_search.conclusion: no all-feasible partition was found in 69653 attempts (best 4 of 5), so exact parent-count equality is not reachable by re-partitioning either
alternative_partition_search.cherry_picking_refused: folds 3 and 5 are individually exactly feasible at 12 slots, but running a mixture of 12-slot and relaxed folds chosen after seeing which are convenient was refused. Every fold uses the same rule: the minimum slot count admitting an exact match.

what_the_upgrade_costs.training_volume: 76.4-85.0 percent of official, against 79.7-87.6 for V2
what_the_upgrade_costs.donor_parent_diversity: 12-15 donor parents instead of 43-51, which is inherent to parent-exclusive donation and is symmetric between arms
what_the_upgrade_costs.metadata_cost: NONE - segments, windows, all 25 strata and target-domain exposure match exactly in every fold

bootstrap_finalisation.frozen: FOLD-STRATIFIED PARENT BOOTSTRAP - resample 12 focal parents with replacement within each of the five folds, retain each selected parent's complete focal-normal segment set, one parent-level delta per selected parent, parent-equal mean of the resampled 60
bootstrap_finalisation.justification: each fold's 12 parents share one fitted PRESENT/ABSENT pair. Free resampling could change the mixture of fitted models and let between-model differences masquerade as parent-sampling noise. Stratifying holds the model mixture fixed, which is coherent with an interval declared conditional on those models.
bootstrap_finalisation.fold_level_reporting: the five fold-level point estimates are reported separately
bootstrap_finalisation.prohibition: N=5 folds is never an inferential sample

unchanged_by_this_phase.primary_estimand: parent-equal-weighted focal concordance delta, MEAN within parent, over the 60 focal parents

remaining_unavoidable_limitations: a residual parent gap of 0 to 3 (ABSENT larger) remains; exact equality is proven unreachable at 12 donor slots for three folds and was not found in 69653 alternative partitions
the interval is conditional on the ten fitted models and estimates no training-model, seed or population uncertainty
donor material differs in signal content from the focal material it replaces; matching is on pre-test metadata only
9 sibling-bearing normal test segments from 2 parents remain outside the focal cohort
11 of 60 focal parents contribute a single normal test segment
training volume falls to 76-85 percent of official, about 3 points below V2

estimator_module_supersession.reason: Phase 3.4D section 9 mandated the fold-stratified bootstrap. The change adds a stratify_by_fold parameter (default True) and the bootstrap_stratified_by_fold flag; the estimator itself - C_i, delta_i, MEAN within parent, parent-equal mean - is byte-for-byte unchanged in behaviour and the point estimate is identical.
